failure.incompatible_connection: Choose a supported OpenAI or OpenRouter API connection.
failure.budget_blocked: The company or task budget prevents this request. Review Costs and Budgets.
failure.provider_auth_failed: The provider rejected the connection. Reconnect it and try again.

failure.fallback: The decision could not be completed. Review its entry in Costs.
